overall_notes: This paper introduces AraEval, an Arabic evaluation suite for LLMs. It primarily focuses on multiple-choice question answering and instruction following tasks. The paper uses automatic evaluation metrics (accuracy, exact match) but does not conduct human evaluation of model outputs or use LLMs as judges. The human validation mentioned was for dataset creation purposes only. The main NLG task evaluated is instruction following via the AraIFEval dataset.
